metadata.description: Wife of Ingwë, High King of the Vanyar. Born at Cuiviénen, likely to the more junior generations of the Minyar. She wed Ingwë before Oromë found the Quendi and invited them to Aman. The couple had several children at Cuiviénen, including Ingwion. In some writings, their daughter (or close relative) Indis married Finwë, King of the Noldor, as his second wife, making Ilwen an ancestress of Fingolfin and Finarfin.
